printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running
printf 'enabled='; systemctl is-enabled inventory-worker.service
printf 'active='; systemctl is-active inventory-worker.service
pid=$(systemctl show inventory-worker.service -p MainPID | sed 's/^MainPID=//')
printf 'process:\n'; ps -p "$pid" -o user= -o group= -o pid= -o stat= -o args=
printf 'log_lines='; sudo wc -l /var/lib/inventory/worker.log
printf 'start_records:\n'; sudo grep '^started ' /var/lib/inventory/worker.log
printf 'log_latest='; sudo tail -n 1 /var/lib/inventory/worker.log
printf 'persisted_probe='; sudo ls -l /var/lib/inventory/write-probe
systemctl show inventory-worker.service -p NoNewPrivileges -p CapabilityBoundingSet -p ReadOnlyDirectories -p ReadWriteDirectories -p User -p Group
printf 'proc_caps='; sudo awk '/^CapPrm:|^CapEff:|^CapBnd:|^CapAmb:/ {printf "%s=%s ",$1,$2} END {print ""}' "/proc/$pid/status"

command:
set -eu
pid=$(systemctl show inventory-worker.service -p MainPID | sed 's/^MainPID=//')
sudo nsenter -t "$pid" -m -- sudo -u inventory-worker sh -c '
  if touch /var/lib/inventory/post-restart-write-probe 2>/dev/null; then echo inside_write=allowed; else echo inside_write=blocked; exit 1; fi
  if touch /tmp/inventory-worker-post-restart-escape 2>/dev/null; then echo outside_tmp_write=ALLOWED; exit 1; else echo outside_tmp_write=blocked; fi
  if touch /var/lib/inventory-worker-post-restart-escape 2>/dev/null; then echo outside_var_write=ALLOWED; exit 1; else echo outside_var_write=blocked; fi
'
printf 'active='; systemctl is-active inventory-worker.service
printf 'latest='; sudo tail -n 1 /var/lib/inventory/worker.log
sudo ls -l /var/lib/inventory/post-restart-write-probe
if [ -e /tmp/inventory-worker-post-restart-escape ] || [ -e /var/lib/inventory-worker-post-restart-escape ]; then echo escape_artifact_present; exit 1; else echo escape_artifacts=absent; fi
